What you’re describing is a ritual that many people find grounding and empowering. It’s a way to transition from "sleep mode" to "I’ve got this" mode, and that’s a beautiful thing. If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush—your routine is already serving you well. But honestly, if this routine brings you joy and makes you feel put-together, there’s no need to change a thing.
